tools.name: search_changelogs
tools.description: Find a public LogPulse changelog by package name, repository, product name or slug. Returns slugs to use with the other tools.

query.description: Package (e.g. @acme/analytics), repository (acme/analytics-js), product name or slug.

tools.name: get_changelog
tools.description: Get a changelog's name, repository, packages, latest version and feed links.

changelog.description: Changelog slug, e.g. "acme". Use search_changelogs to find it from a package, repository or product name.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: List published releases, newest first, with versions, breaking changes, migration steps and deprecations.

changelog.description: Changelog slug, e.g. "acme". Use search_changelogs to find it from a package, repository or product name.

since.description: Only releases published at or after this ISO 8601 time, e.g. 2026-01-01.

breaking_only.description: Only releases that contain breaking changes.

tools.name: get_release
tools.description: Get one release by version (2.0.0 or v2.0.0) or URL slug, with full notes, breaking changes and deprecations.

changelog.description: Changelog slug, e.g. "acme". Use search_changelogs to find it from a package, repository or product name.

release.description: Version like 2.0.0, or the release's URL slug.

tools.name: compare_versions
tools.description: Answer “what changed between two versions, and what do I need to change?”: breaking changes with migration steps, deprecations and every release after `from` up to `to`.

changelog.description: Changelog slug, e.g. "acme". Use search_changelogs to find it from a package, repository or product name.

from.description: The version the user is on, e.g. 1.4.0. Omit to start from the first release.

to.description: The version to upgrade to. Omit for the latest.

format.description: markdown (default) returns an upgrade guide; json returns structured data only.

tools.name: get_roadmap
tools.description: Get the public roadmap: items under review, planned, in progress and shipped, with vote counts.

changelog.description: Changelog slug, e.g. "acme". Use search_changelogs to find it from a package, repository or product name.

tools.name: github_release_notes
tools.description: Write the release notes for a release or tag of a public GitHub repository: compares two of its releases or plain Git tags (default: the latest release vs the one before) and turns the commits and merged pull requests between them into a Keep a Changelog 2.0.0 section with breaking changes flagged and their migration steps, plus plain-language release notes that thank the contributors. With mode "backfill" it writes the notes for each tag in a run of consecutive version tags (up to 10; by default the newest tags that were never published as GitHub releases) and returns a ready-to-run `gh release create <tag> --notes-file …` script that publishes them. Also returns the merged pull requests, the releases and tags to pick from (each labelled release or tag) and how each commit was sorted. Deterministic, no AI, no sign-in.

repository.description: Public github.com repository: "owner/repo" or its URL. A release URL (…/releases/tag/v1.2.0) or compare URL sets the range too.

from.description: The earlier release or tag (not included). Default: the release before `to` (the tag before it for a plain tag). In backfill mode: the tag the run starts after; default: the nearest release before `to`.

to.description: The release or plain tag to write notes for. Default: the latest release. A branch name gives what's merged since `from`. In backfill mode: the newest tag of the run; default: the newest tag without a GitHub release.

mode.description: "single" (default): one release. "backfill": every tag after `from` up to `to`, each compared with the tag before it, plus a script that creates the missing GitHub releases.

include_prereleases.description: Backfill only: include pre-release tags such as v2.0.0-rc.1 in the run. Default false, so each stable release covers everything since the stable one before it.

output.description: What the text answer contains: "both" (default: release notes and Keep a Changelog; in backfill mode also the script), "keep-a-changelog" (CHANGELOG.md sections), "release-notes" (for GitHub releases or an announcement) or "script" (backfill only: the gh script).

tools.name: generate_release_notes
tools.description: Write release notes from a public GitHub repository's commits and merged pull requests: since the last tag by default, between two tags (from/to), or between two dates (since/until). Breaking changes are marked and grouped. Returns Markdown or a Keep a Changelog section ready for CHANGELOG.md, plus a suggested next version. No AI, no sign-in.

repository.description: Public github.com repository: "owner/repo" or its URL. A release, tag or compare URL sets the range too.

from.description: Tag, branch or commit the notes start after (exclusive). Default: the tag before `to`.

to.description: Tag, branch or commit the notes end at. Default: the default branch (unreleased changes). With dates, the branch to read.

since.description: Start date instead of a tag: YYYY-MM-DD (from the start of that day, UTC) or an ISO 8601 time with a time zone.

until.description: End date, included: YYYY-MM-DD (to the end of that day, UTC) or an ISO 8601 time with a time zone. Default: now.

format.description: "markdown" (release notes, the default) or "keep-a-changelog" (a CHANGELOG.md section).

tools.name: validate_changelog
tools.description: Check a CHANGELOG.md against Keep a Changelog 2.0.0: version headings, YYYY-MM-DD dates, newest-first order, the six types of change, breaking-change markers, Unreleased, reference links. Returns each problem with its line number and fix, plus a corrected copy with the safe fixes applied. Pass the text, or a public GitHub repository or changelog file URL.

markdown.description: The changelog text, e.g. the contents of CHANGELOG.md. Use this or url.

url.description: A public github.com repository (its CHANGELOG.md is found for you) or a changelog file URL on github.com or raw.githubusercontent.com. Use this or markdown.

repository_url.description: github.com or gitlab.com repository the changelog belongs to, so missing version links can be written. Not needed with url.

file_name.description: The file's name when it isn't CHANGELOG.md, e.g. "HISTORY.md".

include_fixed.description: Include the corrected copy. Default true.

tools.name: commits_to_changelog
tools.description: Turn git log output or commit messages into a Keep a Changelog 2.0.0 section (Added, Changed, Deprecated, Removed, Fixed, Security) with breaking changes flagged and their migration steps, plus plain-language release notes. Reads Conventional Commits (feat:, fix:, ! and BREAKING CHANGE: footers) and plain subjects; leaves out merges, release commits and chores; stops at the previous release's tag and suggests the next version. Deterministic, nothing stored. Run `git log <last-tag>..HEAD --no-merges` and pass its output as log.

log.description: git log output in any format: full (best, keeps BREAKING CHANGE: footers), --oneline (with --decorate to show tags) or one subject per line. Use this or commits.

commits.description: Commit messages, newest first; each is the subject, optionally followed by a blank line and the body. Use this or log.

version.description: The version being released, e.g. "1.5.0". Leave out for an [Unreleased] section, or to use a tag on the newest commit.

date.description: Release date as YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the tagged commit's date, else today (UTC).

repository_url.description: github.com or gitlab.com repository (or owner/repo for GitHub), for the version compare link and pull request links.

previous_version.description: The last released version, when the log shows no tag: used for the compare link and the suggested next version.

include_chores.description: Keep chore, ci, build, test and style commits (listed under Changed). Default false.

unsorted.description: Entries without a type of change (docs:, deps:): "omit" (default) or "changed" to list them under Changed.

output.description: What the text answer contains: "markdown" (the changelog section), "notes" (release notes) or "both" (default).

tools.name: convert_changelog
tools.description: Turn any project's CHANGELOG.md text, or a GitHub release, releases page, repository or changelog file URL, into a machine-readable changelog: versions, dates, breaking changes with migration steps, and deprecations. Works for projects that aren't on LogPulse. Returns an llms.txt-style summary plus structured JSON.

url.description: GitHub URL: a release (github.com/owner/repo/releases/tag/v1.2.0), the releases page, a repository, or a CHANGELOG.md file. Use this or markdown.

markdown.description: The changelog text itself, e.g. the contents of CHANGELOG.md. Use this or url.

name.description: Project name to use in the summary.

include_notes.description: Include each release's full notes in the JSON. Default false to keep the answer short.

tools.name: publish_release
tools.description: Publish a release note to your LogPulse changelog right after shipping — with version, breaking changes, migration steps and deprecations. Needs a LogPulse API key with the “Publish releases” permission, sent as the Authorization header.

title.description: Short, user-facing headline, e.g. “Webhooks retry automatically”.

version.description: Version this release ships in, e.g. 2.0.0. Unique per changelog.

summary.description: One sentence for lists and link previews.

category.description: new, improved or fixed. Default new.

labels.description: Up to 10 short labels, e.g. API, Dashboard.

status.description: published (default) goes live now, or at published_at. draft saves it for a human to review in LogPulse.

published_at.description: Schedule a future time, or backdate an import.

breaking_changes.description: What breaks for existing users, each with migration steps.

affects.description: What is affected, e.g. REST API, @acme/sdk.

deprecations.description: What is deprecated, its replacement and planned removal version.

author_name.description: Shown as the author. Defaults to the API key's name.

slug.description: URL slug. Defaults to the title.

tools.name: post_roadmap_update
tools.description: Add an item to your LogPulse roadmap, or update one by id — move it to in progress or shipped, change its ETA, or link the release that shipped it. Needs a LogPulse API key with the “Update roadmap” permission, sent as the Authorization header.

id.description: Update this item instead of creating a new one.

description.description: What and why, in a sentence or two.

status.description: Roadmap column. New items default to planned.

label.description: Short tag, e.g. API or Mobile.

eta.description: Free text, e.g. Q3 or July.

is_public.description: Show on the public roadmap. Defaults to true for new items.

linked_release.description: Release id, version or slug that shipped this item.
